title: Eligibility Conditions for Divorcees with Shared Care of Children to Purchase Subsidised HDB Flats
what_it_is: Eligibility Conditions for Divorcees with Shared Care of Children to Purchase Subsidised HDB Flats

sections.label: Divorcees forming family nucleus
sections.summary: Divorcees with children under their legal custody, care and control may form a family nucleus by listing their children as essential occupiers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Divorcees with children under their legal custody, care and control may form a family nucleus, by listing their children as essential occupiers in their flat application.

sections.label: Shared care ex-spouse agreement
sections.summary: Parents with shared care and control must seek their ex-spouse's agreement before listing the child in a flat application.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As any individual can only be listed in one HDB flat application, we require parents with shared care and control to seek their ex-spouse's agreement before listing the child in a flat application.

sections.label: One flat listing and flexibility
sections.summary: Each person can be listed in only one HDB flat, but HDB will exercise flexibility for those facing financial difficulties or lacking family support.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: This is also to be consistent and fair to all HDB flat owners and households, where each person can only be listed in one HDB flat.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: But for those who face challenges in reaching an agreement, HDB will exercise flexibility, if they face financial difficulties or lack family support.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We will ensure that parents with shared care and control have options to provide housing for themselves and their children.

sections.label: Housing counselling for divorcing parties
sections.summary: Feedback on housing counselling will be taken back, and HDB may consider flat applications where interim judgment has addressed the matrimonial flat and custody.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On housing counselling for divorcing parties, I will take her feedback back to make sure that the officers who interact with the divorcing parties are understanding, take all their sharing into consideration and, hopefully, that can help to make the process less taxing for all parties.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I would just like to add that in situations where the settlement of the matrimonial flat and issues of custody and care and control have already been addressed by an interim judgment, for instance, HDB is prepared to consider requests to submit flat applications depending on the facts of the particular case.

sections.label: Shared care numbers and Family Courts
sections.summary: Shared care and control were 4% of divorce care and control Orders as of 2016, and HDB will monitor such cases for housing options.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: So, does the Ministry work closely with the Family Courts  advising and coming up with these guidelines, so that we do not have situations where the couple and the children end up suffering?

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I would first like to add that, in terms of numbers, as of 2016, shared care and control constitute 4% of all divorce care and control Orders.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: As to his point about whether or not we work closely with Family Courts, I think we have to make decisions independently, somewhat.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: But I take his point that we should closely monitor the number of cases where parties are awarded shared care and control and ensure that, when they come to HDB, there are housing options for them on a needs basis.

sections.label: Housing options after divorce
sections.summary: If a party does not own the property after divorce and satisfies the needs-based approach, HDB will work with him on housing options.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: In the specific case that he has mentioned, if the party does not own the property after the divorce comes to HDB and satisfies the needs-based approach that we mentioned, then we will work with him to ensure that he has housing options.
